title: Refresh every unedited stale profile from its newer CV in one counted pass
tests_added: app/_lib/db/profiles-lineage.test.ts (+1 case: edited + updatedAt, and edited:false right after setProfileLineage)
app/_lib/db/profiles-staleness-equivalence.test.ts (oracle extended with profileDivergence; +1 stale-and-edited fixture profile, still deepEqual)
deviations_from_card: (1) ProfileTab.tsx is outside the card's write set: ONE added prop line, onRefreshed={population.reload}. The card predates slot A, which moved the only population reload into ProfileTab; without it a refreshed row keeps its 'Newer CV' badge on the roster and the matrix until the editor next closes, and a second run would re-plan it and hit 409. The alternative (a roster-local overlay of refreshed ids) would re-fork the one population slot A just unified. (2) Case 3 follows the critic's revision: signals = { selfDeclared: f.choice, isEnrolled: f.isEnrolled, expectedGraduation: f.expectedGraduation || undefined, wantsDomainChange: f.wantsDomainChange, hasSubstantialExperience: f.hasSubstantialExperience } over f = formStateFrom(v2), deepEqual AND JSON-byte-equal to the editor body built with the editor's buildProfilePayload. The editor's signals literal lives inline in useProfileEditorSubmit.ts (not in the write set), so case 3b source-pins that literal, the { id: targetId, profile, signals, expectedUpdatedAt, ...lineage } body shape and openFromAnalysis's initialPayload: v2 - editor drift turns it red. (3) An entry that cannot PROVE it is unedited (edited flag absent - the PopulationRow's declared stale type predates it - or no updatedAt to re-assert) is routed to review, never written. StaleMap entries gained optional edited/updatedAt; candidate-population.ts (slot A) was not touched - the route passes profileStaleness's entries through verbatim. (4) Extra cases beyond the card's 8 lines: 2b (unprovable -> review), 6b (429 on the analysis read also stops), 7b (other refusals carry the route's code), 8c (abort before start). A PUT is never given the abort signal, so a Stop never leaves a write's outcome unknown. (5) perf-budget.json (shared surface, under the lock) raised by this card's share only.
